terms: Live terms (v2 props): NBA points / threes / rebounds and NFL receptions / yards / touchdowns and quarterback passing touchdowns / interceptions / completions only, rebounds / threes buy once both ESPN feeds agree, points after the next stoppage + 3 s of clock, NFL 3 s after the next real snap (not a timeout, flag or the same play posting late), NBA rebounds up to $1,000 per market (never more than $500 of it at 99c), NBA threes $500, NBA points $300, every NFL stat $300; rebounds and threes take 98c-or-better stock first and re-fire while it keeps coming back, everything else walks the book from the cheapest ask up to 0.99; crowd must bid 80c or better; a cash shortage never stops the night, clinch waits and fires when money returns; no per-game cap, cash floor $500, night pauses after 2 settled losses (every loss texts), no resting bids.
